R5 — Final exhaustion still falls back to `mutateReviewRecoveryState` when deferral does not apply; added tests assert TOOLING_FAILURE and structured coverage-header failures do not produce deferred entries, preserving prior recovery behavior.

R6 — `tryDeferReviewRetryExhaustion` is called regardless of existing `retryRecovery` fields (no new guard added), and the added test with `recoveryPossible: false` + `unchanged-evidence` still expects deferred carryover.

R9 — `appendMetric` now executes before the final-fail conditional return, so review retry evidence is still recorded; added test checks tenth `reviewRetry` metric remains and deferred finding exists, indicating manual retry-reset evidence is not removed.

R7 — appendDeferredFlowFinding now updates an existing entry when sourceStep/sourceArtifact/sourceFindingId already exists instead of appending, preventing duplicate deferred records across repeated carryover/pre-check invocations.

R8 — Acceptance review now derives deferred findings directly from flow-findings, maps blocking finalDisposition to blocked and still_open to amend_required, and applyAcceptanceReviewResult transitions to user_decision_required with nextAction=user_decision and targetStep=implement after the non-pass review round progression.
